completion_authorization.question: Q-STMT-PROV-01
completion_authorization.decision: A: accept the frozen inventory; report confirmed-generated, explicitly-handwritten and untraced separately; no claim about historical handwriting totals.

category_boundary: Confirmed-generated means identified by the frozen producer/marker inventory. Axiom-pin files are reported separately, not treated as mathematical handwriting. Untraced includes both unmarked source and unresolved Chain/Agreement filenames; no historical handwriting total is inferred.
method: Complete frozen Lean source inventory. Known file producers and documented handwritten exceptions override markers. Unknown provenance remains explicit; no historical authorship certificate inferred.

chain.mechanism: Chain.generate plus #chain/#chain_rest print suggested declarations; sol_chain constructs proof terms. Explicit source declarations are counted once; expanded proof terms are not source LOC.

generator_boundary.agreement: Agreement-named source modules are not automatically generated modules. No canonical file producer has been established for every such path; those records retain untraced provenance.

handwritten_boundary: Only explicit check-corpus.sh exceptions are positively labelled handwritten. Unmarked source and filename candidates are not combined with confirmed handwriting; overall historical handwriting count is unknown.
